prompt: What is the difference between JCheckBox and JRadioButton?
choices: JCheckBox is for numbers; JRadioButton is for text
JCheckBox allows multiple selections; JRadioButton in a ButtonGroup allows only one
JRadioButton can be clicked; JCheckBox cannot
They are identical — just different visual styles
explanation: JCheckBoxes are independent — any combination can be selected. JRadioButtons are grouped using ButtonGroup so that selecting one deselects the others. Use JCheckBox for on/off flags (e.g., 'Subscribe to newsletter') and JRadioButton for mutually exclusive options (e.g., 'Small / Medium / Large').
